gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the details of a specific task by its ID so that I can review its status and assigned resources.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON object containing the task's details, including its title, description, status, assignee, and any comments.

gold.user: As a team lead, I need to cancel a task that is no longer relevant to our project to keep our task list clean and up-to-date.
gold.ideal: The API should return a success message confirming that the task has been canceled, along with the updated status of the task.
